name: apothecary
description: An apothecary's shelf of Claude Code skills — careful remedies for ML/quant work and long sessions. Medicinal plants, not dark: careful work with powerful tools.

plugins.name: feverfew
plugins.description: Rigorous ML/quant experiment discipline — leakage guards, value-identity on reused code, correct holding-period Sharpe, pre-registered grids/gates, smoke-first, OOM-safety, audit-from-artifacts, honest nulls. The herb that guards the run.

plugins.name: erythroxy
plugins.description: JAX/GPU on small hardware, defense AND offense. Defense: VRAM-resident design (live in VRAM while the host thrashes), beating systemd-oomd, chunk/stream, XLA tuning. Offense: the memory hierarchy as a pipeline (generate on-the-fly in VRAM, never read disk in the loop), async overlap, periodic checkpoints, batch-axis parallelism, saturate every FLOP. The apothecary's performance stimulant.

plugins.name: chandoff
plugins.description: Project-tuned compaction rubric written before /compact fires — keep what's load-bearing in your session; writes a durable lore handoff and a paste-ready /compact block.
